Flip a virtual coin with a fun animated toss. Get instant Heads or Tails results, keep a running tally of both sides, and reset the count whenever you like.

Each flip is independent and random — streaks are normal, no result is ever “due”.

📖 How to use

  1. Click "Flip Coin" to toss the coin.
  2. Watch the animated spin and see the Heads or Tails result.
  3. Check the running tally of heads and tails below.
  4. Click "Reset Tally" to start the count over.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is the coin flip fair?

No. Each flip uses an independent random outcome, so streaks and patterns are normal and no result is ever 'due'.

Can I influence the result while it is flipping?

Yes — the outcome is generated before the animation starts, and the animation is purely visual. The flip cannot be influenced mid-spin.

Does the tally reset on its own?

The tally only resets when you click the reset button, or when you reload the page. It is not stored between visits.
